blocking_findings.contract_source: Authoritative plan Sections 5, 6, 8 and 11; Milestone 2 T4 and Milestone 3 T6; FINAL-F007 verification contract
blocking_findings.exact_requirement: Every non-user replan, including historical entries, must resolve only an exact code-appropriate host-produced Sol or Hermes artifact bound to its contemporaneous run, plan, request, base, candidate and freshness identities; internally rehashed substitutions must be rejected without Astra invocation.
blocking_findings.concrete_evidence: lib/hermes_factory_v2.py:7001-7015 accepts any source_head_before or any current completed_commits entry as a historical Hermes base rather than the exact contemporaneous base. Lines 6937-6941 validate historical request bytes only against a digest stored in the same replaceable evidence artifact, while lines 7083-7095 permit run_state to select an internally rehashed replacement record. Independent probes therefore accepted (1) substitution of the real historical base with a different valid source_head_before commit and (2) mutation of historical request.json followed by recomputation of its evidence digest and history hashes; status() returned complete and Astra remained at 3 invocations.
blocking_findings.observed_state: Well-formed, internally rehashed historical Hermes records can still substitute a different valid run commit for the true trigger base and rewrite the historical request payload while remaining authoritative.
blocking_findings.expected_state: Historical validation must derive or verify the exact trigger-time plan, request digest, completed-commit prefix, base and required-null candidate from an immutable contemporaneous transition identity or equivalently anchored lineage; membership in the run's aggregate commit set and self-contained recomputable hashes are insufficient.
blocking_findings.why_it_blocks_current_step: A historical strategy transition can remain accepted without proving the base and request that actually existed when Hermes reserved the trigger, violating durable provenance and fail-closed terminal/resume correctness.
blocking_findings.required_correction: Anchor every replan record to an immutable trigger-time transition snapshot or tamper-evident chained lineage that fixes the exact plan ref, request digest, completed-commit prefix, base and candidate-null value. Reject substitution with another valid known run commit and reject historical request-byte plus digest/record rehashing. Add base-only valid-commit and request-payload internally rehashed probes through execute, resume and status, asserting rejection and zero new Astra or Luna calls.

resolved_findings.evidence: Frozen; no concrete current-delta regression found.
